    41→
    42→class DashboardDataLoader:
    43→    """Loads experiment data from results directories and optionally Phoenix."""
    44→
    45→    def __init__(self, phoenix_endpoint: str, results_base_dir: Path):
    46→        self.phoenix_endpoint = phoenix_endpoint
    47→        self.results_dir = Path(results_base_dir)
    48→        self._phoenix_client = None
    49→        self._phoenix_available = False
    50→        self._cache_lock = threading.Lock()
    51→        self._run_index: dict[str, Path] = {}  # run_id -> canonical results dir
    52→        self._metrics_cache: dict[str, dict] = {}
    53→        self._trace_cache: dict[str, dict] = {}
    54→
    55→        self._init_phoenix()
    56→        self._build_run_index()
    57→
    58→    def _init_phoenix(self):
    59→        """Try to connect to Phoenix. Set _phoenix_available flag."""
    60→        if not _PHOENIX_AVAILABLE:
    61→            return
    62→        try:
    63→            self._phoenix_client = px.Client(endpoint=self.phoenix_endpoint)
    64→            self._phoenix_client.get_spans_dataframe(limit=1)
    65→            self._phoenix_available = True
    66→        except Exception:
    67→            self._phoenix_available = False
    68→            self._phoenix_client = None
    69→
    70→    def _build_run_index(self):
    71→        """
    72→        Scan results/ directory names to build run_id -> directory mapping.
    73→        When a run_id maps to multiple directories, prefer the SLURM-job-ID
    74→        format (shorter middle segment) as canonical.
    75→        """
    76→        if not self.results_dir.is_dir():
    77→            return
    78→
    79→        # Collect all candidate dirs per run_id
    80→        candidates: dict[str, list[Path]] = {}
    81→        for d in sorted(self.results_dir.iterdir()):
    82→            if not d.is_dir():
    83→                continue
    84→            m = RUN_ID_PATTERN.search(d.name)
    85→            if m:
    86→                rid = m.group(1)
    87→                candidates.setdefault(rid, []).append(d)
    88→
    89→        with self._cache_lock:
    90→            for rid, dirs in candidates.items():
    91→                if len(dirs) == 1:
    92→                    self._run_index[rid] = dirs[0]
    93→                else:
    94→                    # Prefer SLURM format: {name}_{job_id}_{run_id}
    95→                    # The segment before run_id in SLURM format is all digits
    96→                    best = dirs[0]
    97→                    for d in dirs:
    98→                        # Remove the run_id suffix, check preceding segment
    99→                        prefix = d.name[: -(len(rid) + 1)]  # remove _<run_id>
   100→                        parts = prefix.rsplit("_", 1)
   101→                        if len(parts) == 2 and _SLURM_JOB_ID_RE.match(parts[1]):
   102→                            best = d
   103→                            break
   104→                    self._run_index[rid] = best
   105→
   106→    def _parse_dir_metadata(self, run_id: str, d: Path) -> dict:
   107→        """Extract metadata from a results directory without loading large files."""
   108→        meta = {
   109→            "run_id": run_id,
   110→            "results_dir": str(d),
   111→            "has_metrics": (d / "metrics.json").exists(),
   112→            "has_trace": (d / "trace.json").exists(),
   113→            "has_config": (d / "config_snapshot.yaml").exists(),
   114→        }
   115→
   116→        # Try to get basic info from trace.json (lightweight: read top-level keys only)
   117→        if meta["has_trace"]:
   118→            try:
   119→                with open(d / "trace.json") as f:
   120→                    trace_data = json.load(f)
   121→                meta["experiment_name"] = trace_data.get("experiment", {}).get("name", "")
   122→                meta["model"] = trace_data.get("llm", {}).get("model", "")
   123→                meta["provider"] = trace_data.get("llm", {}).get("provider", "")
   124→                meta["status"] = trace_data.get("status", "unknown")
   125→                meta["total_turns"] = len(trace_data.get("turns", []))
   126→                meta["total_duration"] = trace_data.get("timing", {}).get("total_duration_seconds", 0)
   127→                timing = trace_data.get("timing", {})
   128→                meta["start_time"] = timing.get("start_time", "")
   129→
   130→                # Sum token/cost from turns
   131→                turns = trace_data.get("turns", [])
   132→                meta["total_input_tokens"] = sum(t.get("input_tokens", 0) for t in turns)
   133→                meta["total_output_tokens"] = sum(t.get("output_tokens", 0) for t in turns)
   134→                meta["total_cost_usd"] = sum(t.get("cost_usd", 0) for t in turns)
   135→            except Exception:
   136→                pass
   137→
   138→        # Try to get accuracy from metrics.json (small file)
   139→        if meta["has_metrics"]:
   140→            try:
   141→                metrics = self.get_run_metrics(run_id)
   142→                if metrics:
   143→                    meta["accuracy"] = metrics.get("overall_summary", {}).get("avg_accuracy_excl_empty")
   144→                    meta["column_mapping_accuracy"] = metrics.get("column_mapping", {}).get("accuracy")
   145→                    md = metrics.get("metadata", {})
   146→                    # Fill in model/provider from metrics if not from trace
   147→                    if not meta.get("model"):
   148→                        meta["model"] = md.get("llm_model", "")
   149→                    if not meta.get("provider"):
   150→                        meta["provider"] = md.get("llm_provider", "")
   151→                    if not meta.get("experiment_name"):
   152→                        meta["experiment_name"] = md.get("experiment_name", "")
   153→            except Exception:
   154→                pass
   155→
   156→        # Fill defaults for missing fields
   157→        meta.setdefault("experiment_name", d.name)
   158→        meta.setdefault("model", "")

    11→def discover_metrics_files(metrics_files: list[str] | None = None, metrics_globs: list[str] | None = None) -> list[Path]:
    12→    paths: set[Path] = set()
    13→    for item in metrics_files or []:
    14→        p = Path(item).expanduser()
    15→        if p.is_file() and p.name == "metrics.json":
    16→            paths.add(p.resolve())
    17→        elif p.is_dir():
    18→            candidate = p / "metrics.json"
    19→            if candidate.exists():
    20→                paths.add(candidate.resolve())
    21→    for pattern in metrics_globs or []:
    22→        for p in Path().glob(pattern):
    23→            if p.is_file() and p.name == "metrics.json":
    24→                paths.add(p.resolve())
    25→    return sorted(paths)
    26→
    27→
    28→def extract_run_id(path: Path, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    29→    experiment_name = data.get("metadata", {}).get("experiment_name", "")
    30→    m = RUN_ID_PATTERN.search(experiment_name)
    31→    if m:
    32→        return m.group(1)
    33→    parent = path.parent.name
    34→    m = RUN_ID_PATTERN.search(parent)
    35→    return m.group(1) if m else parent
    36→

    38→def load_metrics_bundle(paths: list[Path]) -> tuple[list[tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]], list[dict[str, str]]]:
    39→    loaded: list[tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]] = []
    40→    skipped: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    41→    for path in paths:
    42→        try:
    43→            data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    44→            if "column_mapping" not in data or "column_values" not in data or "overall_summary" not in data:
    45→                skipped.append({"file": str(path), "reason": "missing required keys"})
    46→                continue
    47→            loaded.append((path, data))
    48→        except Exception as exc:
    49→            skipped.append({"file": str(path), "reason": str(exc)})
    50→    return loaded, skipped

   252→def build_tables(bundle: list[tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]], labels_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
   253→    runs, mapping_rows, column_rows, confusion_rows = [], [], [], []
   254→
   255→    for path, data in bundle:
   256→        run = _run_row(path, data)
   257→        run_id = run["run_id"]
   258→        runs.append(run)
   259→
   260→        for detail in data.get("column_mapping", {}).get("details", []):
   261→            mapping_rows.append(
   262→                {
   263→                    "run_id": run_id,
   264→                    "experiment_name": run["experiment_name"],
   265→                    "model_label": run["model_label"],
   266→                    "context": run["context"],
   267→                    "source_column": detail.get("source_column"),
   268→                    "expected_target": detail.get("expected_target"),
   269→                    "actual_target": detail.get("actual_target"),
   270→                    "is_correct": detail.get("is_correct", False),
   271→                    "is_acceptable": detail.get("is_acceptable", False),
   272→                    "is_missing": detail.get("is_missing", False),
   273→                    "is_explicitly_null": detail.get("is_explicitly_null", False),
   274→                    "is_wrong": detail.get("is_wrong", False),
   275→                }
   276→            )
   277→
   278→        for col_name, payload in data.get("column_values", {}).items():
   279→            entry = {
   280→                "run_id": run_id,
   281→                "experiment_name": run["experiment_name"],
   282→                "model_label": run["model_label"],
   283→                "context": run["context"],
   284→                "column_name": col_name,
   285→                "source_column_name": payload.get("source_column_name"),
   286→            }
   287→            for key in COLUMN_VALUE_FIELDS:
   288→                entry[key] = payload.get(key)
   289→            errors = payload.get("error_categorization", {})
   290→            entry["error_total"] = errors.get("total_errors")
   291→            entry["error_whitespace_only"] = errors.get("whitespace_only")
   292→            entry["error_case_only"] = errors.get("case_only")
   293→            entry["error_whitespace_and_case"] = errors.get("whitespace_and_case")
   294→            entry["error_genuine"] = errors.get("genuine")
   295→            column_rows.append(entry)
   296→
   297→            for expected, preds in (payload.get("confusion_matrix") or {}).items():
   298→                for predicted, count in (preds or {}).items():
   299→                    confusion_rows.append(
   300→                        {
   301→                            "run_id": run_id,
   302→                            "column_name": col_name,
   303→                            "expected_value": expected,
   304→                            "predicted_value": predicted,
   305→                            "count": count,
   306→                        }
   307→                    )
   308→
   309→    runs_df = pd.DataFrame(runs)
   310→    if not runs_df.empty and labels_df is not None and not labels_df.empty:
   311→        runs_df = merge_labels(runs_df, labels_df)
   312→
   313→    mapping_df = pd.DataFrame(mapping_rows)
   314→    columns_df = pd.DataFrame(column_rows)
   315→    confusion_df = pd.DataFrame(confusion_rows)
   316→
   317→    merge_cols = ["run_id", "display_label", "model_family"]
   318→    for extra in ["model_family_group", "cost_tier", "is_local"]:
   319→        if extra in runs_df.columns:
   320→            merge_cols.append(extra)
   321→
   322→    if not runs_df.empty and not columns_df.empty:
   323→        columns_df = columns_df.merge(
   324→            runs_df[merge_cols],
   325→            on="run_id",
   326→            how="left",
   327→        )
   328→    if not runs_df.empty and not mapping_df.empty:
   329→        mapping_df = mapping_df.merge(
   330→            runs_df[merge_cols],
   331→            on="run_id",
   332→            how="left",
   333→        )
   334→
   335→    tables = {
   336→        "runs": runs_df,
   337→        "column_mapping": mapping_df,
   338→        "column_values": columns_df,
   339→        "confusion": confusion_df,
   340→    }
   341→
   342→    # Add row_values if any row_values.csv files exist
   343→    if not runs_df.empty:
   344→        row_values_df = build_row_values_table(runs_df)
   345→        if not row_values_df.empty:
   346→            tables["row_values"] = row_values_df
   347→
   348→    return tables
   349→
   350→
   351→def build_row_values_table(runs_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
   352→    """Discover and concatenate row_values.csv files from each run's results_dir.
   353→
   354→    Merges in run metadata (model_label, context, display_label).
   355→
   356→    Returns long-format DataFrame with columns:
   357→        run_id, model_label, context, display_label, column_name,
   358→        source_column_name, row_index, gold_value, predicted_value,
   359→        classification, error_type
   360→    """
   361→    frames = []
   362→    for _, run in runs_df.iterrows():
   363→        results_dir = run.get("results_dir")
   364→        if not results_dir:
   365→            continue
   366→        rv_path = Path(results_dir) / "row_values.csv"
   367→        if not rv_path.exists():
   368→            continue
   369→        df = pd.read_csv(rv_path, dtype=str)
   370→        df["run_id"] = run["run_id"]
   371→        frames.append(df)
   372→
   373→    if not frames:
   374→        return pd.DataFrame()
   375→
   376→    row_values = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
   377→
   378→    # Merge run metadata
   379→    merge_cols = ["run_id", "model_label", "context", "display_label"]
   380→    merge_cols = [c for c in merge_cols if c in runs_df.columns]
   381→    row_values = row_values.merge(
   382→        runs_df[merge_cols],
   383→        on="run_id",
   384→        how="left",
   385→    )
   386→    return row_values

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Generate overview visualizations for ALL March 11, 2026 experiment runs (including the 15 failed runs that have no metrics.json). This supplements the standard CLI output (which only covers the 3 successful runs with metrics.json) by adding: - Completion heatmap (success/fail grid, all 18 model x context combos) - Failure mode distribution bar chart - Interactive Plotly versions of the above + sunburst/treemap of failures Uses the existing evaluation visualization infrastructure: - src/evaluation/visualization/plots.save_figure for saving - src/dashboard/data_loader.DashboardDataLoader for run discovery - src/evaluation/visualization/io for metrics loading Usage: cd harmonia_metadata_agent/analysis/dstoker/harmonia .venv/bin/python results/plots/generate_march11_experiment_overview.py """ from __future__ import annotations import json import re import sys from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import pandas as pd # Add src/ to path so we can reuse the existing evaluation infrastructure _PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] sys.path.insert(0, str(_PROJECT_ROOT / "src")) from evaluation.visualization.plots import save_figure # Conditional imports — same pattern as plots.py try: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import seaborn as sns SEABORN_READY = True except ImportError: SEABORN_READY = False try: import plotly.express as px import plotly.graph_objects as go PLOTLY_READY = True except ImportError: PLOTLY_READY = False # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Constants # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- RESULTS_DIR = _PROJECT_ROOT / "results" OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent MARCH_11_DATE_TOKEN = "20260311" # Canonical models and contexts for this experiment batch MODELS = [ "qwen3.5:9b", "qwen3.5:4b", "qwen3.5:27b", "deepseek-v3.2", "gemma-3-27b-it", "mistral-nemo", ] CONTEXTS = ["bdikit-tools", "code-context", "codeact"] # Map directory model tokens to canonical model names _MODEL_DIR_MAP = { "qwen3.5-9b": "qwen3.5:9b", "qwen3.5-4b": "qwen3.5:4b", "qwen3.5-27b": "qwen3.5:27b", "deepseek-v3.2": "deepseek-v3.2", "gemma-3-27b-it": "gemma-3-27b-it", "mistral-nemo": "mistral-nemo", } # Dir pattern: dou_harmonization_{context}_{model}_{date}_{time}_{runid} _DIR_PATTERN = re.compile( r"dou_harmonization_" r"(?Pbdikit-tools|code-context|codeact)_" r"(?P[^_]+(?:-[^_]+)*)_" r"(?P\d{8})_(?P\d{6})_" r"(?P[0-9a-f]{8})$" ) # Known failure reasons (from user-provided data + log analysis) FAILURE_REASONS = { ("gemma-3-27b-it", "bdikit-tools"): "Tool calling not supported", ("gemma-3-27b-it", "code-context"): "Tool calling not supported", ("gemma-3-27b-it", "codeact"): "Tool calling not supported", ("qwen3.5:4b", "bdikit-tools"): "Model not found / pre-load timeout", ("qwen3.5:4b", "code-context"): "Model not found / pre-load timeout", ("qwen3.5:4b", "codeact"): "Model not found / pre-load timeout", ("qwen3.5:27b", "bdikit-tools"): "Model not found / pre-load timeout", ("qwen3.5:27b", "code-context"): "Model not found / pre-load timeout", ("qwen3.5:27b", "codeact"): "Model not found / pre-load timeout", ("mistral-nemo", "bdikit-tools"): "No output produced", ("mistral-nemo", "code-context"): "No output produced", ("mistral-nemo", "codeact"): "No output produced", ("deepseek-v3.2", "bdikit-tools"): "Completed but no output file", ("deepseek-v3.2", "code-context"): "Completed but no output file", ("qwen3.5:9b", "codeact"): "Codeact timeout", } # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Data discovery — reuses directory scanning pattern from data_loader.py # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def discover_march11_runs() -> pd.DataFrame: """Scan results/ for March 11 directories, deduplicate to latest per model x context.""" records = [] for d in sorted(RESULTS_DIR.iterdir()): if not d.is_dir(): continue m = _DIR_PATTERN.match(d.name) if not m: continue if m.group("date") != MARCH_11_DATE_TOKEN: continue model_token = m.group("model_token") model = _MODEL_DIR_MAP.get(model_token, model_token) context = m.group("context") run_id = m.group("run_id") timestamp = m.group("date") + m.group("time") has_metrics = (d / "metrics.json").exists() # Load metrics summary if available metrics_data = {} if has_metrics: try: raw = json.loads((d / "metrics.json").read_text()) cm = raw.get("column_mapping", {}) os_ = raw.get("overall_summary", {}) metrics_data = { "column_mapping_accuracy": cm.get("accuracy"), "avg_value_accuracy_excl_empty": os_.get("avg_accuracy_excl_empty"), "avg_value_accuracy_incl_empty": os_.get("avg_accuracy_incl_empty"), "avg_value_f1_excl_empty": os_.get("avg_f1_excl_empty"), "avg_value_f1_incl_empty": os_.get("avg_f1_incl_empty"), "total_hallucinations": os_.get("total_hallucinations", 0), "total_omissions": os_.get("total_omissions", 0), "total_genuine_errors": os_.get("total_genuine_errors", 0), } except Exception: pass records.append({ "model": model, "context": context, "run_id": run_id, "timestamp": timestamp, "results_dir": str(d), "has_metrics": has_metrics, "produced_output": has_metrics, **metrics_data, }) df = pd.DataFrame(records) if df.empty: return df # Deduplicate: keep latest timestamp per (model, context) df = df.sort_values("timestamp", ascending=False).drop_duplicates( subset=["model", "context"], keep="first" ).reset_index(drop=True) # Add failure reasons for unsuccessful runs df["failure_reason"] = df.apply( lambda row: None if row["produced_output"] else FAILURE_REASONS.get((row["model"], row["context"]), "Unknown"), axis=1, ) # Display label df["display_label"] = df["model"] + " | " + df["context"] return df # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Seaborn plots # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def seaborn_completion_heatmap(all_runs: pd.DataFrame, out_dir: Path): """Heatmap: completion status (produced output yes/no) by model x context.""" if not SEABORN_READY: print(" SKIP: seaborn not available") return # Build pivot grid = all_runs.pivot_table( index="model", columns="context", values="produced_output", aggfunc="first", ).reindex(index=MODELS, columns=CONTEXTS).fillna(False).astype(int) # Build annotation matrix with failure reasons annot_rows = [] for model in grid.index: row = [] for context in grid.columns: val = grid.loc[model, context] if val == 1: row.append("OK") else: match = all_runs[ (all_runs["model"] == model) & (all_runs["context"] == context) ] if not match.empty: reason = match.iloc[0].get("failure_reason", "N/A") short = (reason[:20] + "...") if reason and len(reason) > 20 else (reason or "N/A") row.append(short) else: row.append("N/A") annot_rows.append(row) annot_df = pd.DataFrame(annot_rows, index=grid.index, columns=grid.columns) sns.set_theme(style="white", font_scale=1.1) fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7)) cmap = sns.color_palette(["#ffc7ce", "#c6efce"]) sns.heatmap( grid, annot=annot_df, fmt="",
